question: The following data were collected by a researcher over seven successive years from a population of a fish in a pond. He calculated population growth rate (7) for each year using this formula r= In Nea InN, Note: N= the population size, K= the carrying capacity. Year Number of Fish Population growth rate (r)
source: IBO 2018 理论考试 2（Theoretical Exam 2）第 46 题

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The fish population grows exponentially as r is bigger than 1 in all years

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: When fecundity is less than mortality we can assume N < K, which means that the population is growing

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The fraction of the resources that were used by the fish in each year can be calculated by N/K

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The pond carrying capacity (K) is between 62 and 72
